confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Albufeira's July peak-season price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, café and beer anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel rates are least certain because July accommodation prices vary widely by property, date and booking lead time. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against draft beer using typical resort-bar price ratios because direct knowledge of exact prices is weak. The FX observation came from rba.gov.au search results for the 15 October 2026 4:00 pm figure; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is the Algarve coastal resort market (similar to Lagos and Portimão) and typical southern European beach-resort prices during the July high season.
